_comment: Ceiling floors measured against grove v0.30.0 / prism v0.42.0 (2026-08-10), post multi-hop receiver-chain fix (generic-constraint extends, Java field chains, out-of-scope member binding). A run scoring below (baseline - tolerance) on any corpus is a regression: either an engine defect reintroduced, or a genuine improvement that should update this file deliberately, not silently. The one remaining recall residual (guava MutableClassToInstanceMap.spliterator — delegate() call inside an anonymous inner class, attributed at the astkit layer) and the precision residuals are documented in paper.tex Results II / Mechanism and are NOT bugs to chase here.
